tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Finds dated events in Paris by time window, subject, price, free text or distance from a point. Returns each event with its page URL and, where we hold one, a booking link. Relaxes the window or radius when fewer than three events match, and says so in `relaxed`.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Returns one event by slug: its dates, venue, subject tags, our own description where we have written one, and a booking link where we hold an offer. Use it after search_events, or when you already have an event URL.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Finds cafés, parks, museums, pools, libraries and other places in Paris by kind, amenity, whether they are open now, or distance from a point. Each place carries how reliably it stays cool, what it suits, and its page URL.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Returns one place by slug with its address, coordinates, amenities, opening hours and how reliably it stays cool, plus the nearest other places. Use it after search_places, or when you already have a place URL.

tools.name: search_all
tools.description: Searches events, activities, places and guides at once by name or text, for when the kind of thing is not known in advance. Each hit says which kind it is and carries the slug to pass to get_event or get_place.

tools.name: moment_now
tools.description: Returns the seasonal or cultural moment currently running in Paris — Fashion Week, Christmas, a heatwave — with its hub URL and dates, or the city's seasonal mode when none is running.

description: Returns prepaid eSIM data plans that work in France, for a given amount of data and trip length. Each plan carries its price with the date that price was checked, and a booking link. Relevant when a reader is travelling to Paris from outside the EU and needs mobile data on arrival.
